description: Test prompts covering the nine operations of the knowledge-base skill. Each prompt should route to its named operation and produce schema-valid KB output.

evals.name: refresh-routine
evals.prompt: Refresh the Claude tooling KB — has anything new shipped since last week?
evals.expected_output: Skill invokes Phase A state-tracker; if delta empty, reports 'no upstream changes since last refresh'; if non-empty, proceeds to Phase B with candidate list and writes gap articles via parallel Haiku subagents.

evals.name: maintain-url-validity
evals.prompt: Audit the KB URLs for staleness — re-verify the SDK feature pages still resolve.
evals.expected_output: Skill runs M1 (URL validity) across articles tagged agents/coding-agents written in last 90 days; reports 200/404 per article; flags articles where source_url 404s and updates ## Maintenance note (does NOT delete articles).

evals.name: ingest-user-draft
evals.prompt: I have a draft article on the new Codex MCP support at /tmp/codex-mcp-draft.md — please ingest it into the KB with appropriate tags.
evals.expected_output: Skill runs I1 (lint), I2 (dedupe check), I3 (ingest with frontmatter tags). If lint fails, surfaces specific frontmatter errors. If duplicate-suspect, asks user before ingest. Updates codex-sdk-rubric to add row.

evals.name: audit-full-coverage
evals.prompt: Is our KB current across all four surfaces? Do a full coverage check, no delta gate.
evals.expected_output: Skill runs REFRESH workflow without delta gate. Every feature on references/surface-urls.md becomes a candidate. Output is coverage matrix (covered vs gap) per surface, then Phase B writes new gap articles.

evals.name: search-with-query-expansion
evals.prompt: What do we know in the KB about preventing parallel tool calls in subagents?
evals.expected_output: Skill runs S1 (smart query) → returns can_use_tool article, AgentDefinition.maxTurns article, per-phase allowed_tools article. Top result is can_use_tool with score in range (-5, -10).

evals.name: dedupe-overlap-check
evals.prompt: Find any overlapping articles in the Claude Agent SDK section — are there duplicates I should merge?
evals.expected_output: Skill runs D1 (title-token overlap analysis on agent-sdk-tagged articles). Flags pairs with >50% overlap. User-facing summary lists candidate pairs for review with merge/keep-both/supersede options.

evals.name: rubric-edit
evals.prompt: Update the Codex SDK rubric — I just ingested an article on `codex exec` that needs to appear in the rubric table.
evals.expected_output: Skill runs R1 (read codex-sdk-rubric to /tmp/), R2 (locate appropriate table, append row with article slug + docs URL), R3 (re-ingest preserving short title). Verify post-ingest read returns updated content.

evals.name: trigger-monthly-cadence
evals.prompt: It's been a month since the last KB refresh — run the routine.
evals.expected_output: Same as eval 1; skill should trigger on the cadence framing alone, even without explicit 'refresh the KB' wording.

evals.name: learning-from-validated-session-friction
evals.prompt: $knowledge-base learning — encode the non-obvious, reusable lessons from this session for agents doing similar work.
evals.expected_output: Skill mines the active session, applies all five learning gates, performs two novelty searches per candidate, distinguishes upstream facts from live session evidence, writes atomic 200–400 word drafts, strict-lints and ingests only passing articles, rebuilds the browser, and verifies likely stuck-agent queries return each article in the top three.

evals.name: learning-clean-no-op
evals.prompt: $knowledge-base learning — this session completed cleanly using already-documented steps; capture only genuinely novel lessons.
evals.expected_output: Skill rejects generic, already-documented, or unevidenced candidates and reports a clean zero-article no-op instead of manufacturing a lesson.
